components.name: MultiCityPlanGrid
components.description: All-leg booking workflow for distinct city stops with an optional final return to the origin. It owns every resolved leg in the artifact; composes CityField, TravelDate, TransportSelect, FareOrder and FadeFares per leg, inserts StayDuration for each destination, and cascades selected arrival plus stay into the next leg minimum departure

score.name: MultiCityPlanGrid
score.rationale: The combined workflow represented all legs and fixed internal controls correctly.

components.name: FareCalendar
components.description: Bound-leg flexible-dates booking workflow within one exact display date window. Use exactly one FareCalendar for each requested leg when calendars are the trip booking interface. legIndex is the stable zero-based logical leg identity and datasetRef is its initial load handle. It uses that leg modes and minimum departure, defaults each day to its local cheapest synthetic fare, and opens that day fares without sending rows to the model

score.name: FareCalendar
score.rationale: Grounded date fares rendered responsively; the archived run lacks the deeper interaction trace captured for PriceCalendar.

components.name: FadeFares
components.description: Same-leg bounded vertically scrollable synthetic fare-card grid. It progressively requests cursor pages near the bottom instead of preloading the dataset, retries failed appends, and resets loaded pages plus scroll position when the effective leg, date, mode, price or sort input changes. legIndex is the stable zero-based logical leg identity and datasetRef is its initial load handle; each loaded page keeps its exact display provenance, and selections flow to the shared PlanningTracker

score.name: FadeFares
score.rationale: Scrollable leg fares rendered in direct and combined editors with valid source rows.

components.name: FareOrder
components.description: Same-leg fare ordering control. legIndex is the stable zero-based logical leg identity and datasetRef is its initial load handle; cheapest orders price, fastest orders duration, and departure orders service date then departure time. Cheapest and fastest also set the matching FareCalendar objective; departure leaves its default cheapest objective

score.name: FareOrder
score.rationale: The leg-scoped order control rendered in direct editors; evidence is narrower than for the main filter controls.

components.name: TransportSelect
components.description: Same-leg transport selector for modes with available fares. legIndex is the stable zero-based logical leg identity and datasetRef is its initial load handle. Uses a compact multi-select dropdown with vector icons inside MultiCityPlanGrid and inline toggles when rendered alone; writes modesByLeg for the current route and filters its FadeFares and FareCalendar

score.name: TransportSelect
score.rationale: Selecting Train constrained the visible first-leg fares to train options.

components.name: StayDuration
components.description: Destination stay slider from 0 to 30 days. legIndex is the stable zero-based logical leg identity and datasetRef is its initial arriving-leg handle; its destination becomes the next leg origin, and selected arrival plus this stay sets the next minimum departure

score.name: StayDuration
score.rationale: Changing a Paris stay from two to three nights shifted the onward schedule by one day.

components.name: TravelDate
